hooks.name: invariant-review-on-risk-change
hooks.description: After the agent edits risk-engine, agent or server code, re-check the core safety invariant: the LLM can only add friction, never release a transaction.

action.prompt: You just edited risk/agent/server code. Before continuing, check the change against .kiro/steering/safety-invariants.md: (1) can any LLM output, error or timeout lower the required approval level or cause a transaction to be sent without the checks the rules require? (2) do LLM failures fail closed (REQUIRE_GUARDIAN or BLOCK)? (3) is any key, mnemonic or personal data sent to the LLM? If any answer is a problem, fix it and add or update a property-based test that would have caught it. Report the result in one or two lines.
